errors.evidence: The description claims the percentage labels are written inside the sectors, but the image clearly shows them outside the sectors, with lines pointing to the respective slices.

errors.text_span: Всички сектори са визуално представени като изнесени от кръга
errors.evidence: The phrase 'изнесени от кръга' (taken out of the circle) is an ambiguous and not entirely accurate way to describe the visual separation between the 3D pie slices. A more precise description would be that the slices are separated by gaps.
